newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat around 229 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat around 229 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 229.00/30 per dollar, flat from 229.00/50 at the opening of the interbank market but lower than Wednesday's close at 227.20/50 due to the longer value date of spot deals, dealers said.
"Trade was very thin and calm with the lev idling around 229 to the dollar, some two levs weaker than yesterday due to the longer value date (of today's spot deals)," a commercial bank dealer said.
Those deals will be settled on Monday, allowing dollar buyers to profit on high yield lev deposits during the weekend.
The current large spread between interest rates on lev-denominated and dollar-denominated investments allows for a daily lev's easing by some 0.7 levs to the dollar, dealers said.
Foreign currency demand was relatively low, with small offers from the central bank to bring about the lev's stability in today's trade, dealers said.

"Unlike its active support for the lev in the past several days, the central bank today appeared sporadically in the market probably because there were fewer dollar bids at higher exchange rates," another dealer said.
According to some dealers, the central bank sold dollars at 227.50/228 levs.
Central bank officials were not available for comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
